# No Code Founder

> No Code Founder is a web development, custom software (CRM/ERP), and digital marketing (SEO, Google Ads, Facebook Ads) agency serving businesses in the USA, the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia), and India.

No Code Founder builds fast, SEO-optimized custom websites, bespoke CRM and ERP systems (with no per-user licensing fees), and runs ROI-driven Google Ads, Facebook/Meta Ads, and SEO/GEO AIO (Generative Engine & AI Optimization) campaigns. Clients retain full ownership of their source code and IP.

## Services
- Website Development — custom, fast, responsive, SEO-optimized websites (Next.js, headless architectures).
- Custom CRM Solutions — bespoke Customer Relationship Management systems built around a client's exact sales workflow.
- ERP Systems — Enterprise Resource Planning software for operations, inventory, HR, and finance.
- SEO Optimization / GEO AIO — search and generative-engine optimization for the USA, GCC, and Indian markets.
- Google Marketing — Google Search Ads, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube campaign management.
- Facebook Marketing — Meta/Facebook Ads, lookalike audiences, and B2B lead generation campaigns.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://nocodefounder.site/): overview of services, portfolio ("Our Work"), and a free-consultation booking form.

- [Blog](https://nocodefounder.site/blog): articles on web development trends, GEO AIO/SEO strategy, CRM vs. Salesforce, Google/Facebook Ads ROI, and CRM-ERP integration.
